selection_rule: 每方法、每错误类别至多1例；优先种子17，再29，随后test_id、test_ood、test_counterfactual及升序id。
metric_source: strict main metrics use score_response on original prediction text and canonical rows; lenient_answer_correct and normalized_joint_correct are diagnostic only

diagnostic_metric_definitions.normalized_joint_correct: score_response after removing only one outer ```json ... ``` fence

definitions.gold_pair_counts: counted from canonical test_counterfactual rows grouped by pair_id
definitions.strict_answer_extraction: one JSON object, exact keys answer/evidence, answer is string; same parse/key/type preconditions as score_response.answer_correct
definitions.changed_behavior_rate: on all gold-answer-changed pairs, both strict answers parse and predicted answers differ
definitions.correct_answer_change_rate: on all gold-answer-changed pairs, both predicted answers equal their respective gold answers
definitions.unchanged_answer_consistency_rate: on all gold-answer-unchanged pairs, both strict answers parse and predictions match
definitions.denominator_policy: all canonical pairs in the relevant gold category; missing or unparseable outputs count as failures
